title: PB21이 수요일 오전8시에 적용됩니다.
bodyHtml:
Publish 21 Worldwide Release Nov 24 2003 8:17PM CST (GMT -06:00) 
Publish 21, which was released to the Pacific shard on the morning of Monday, November 24 CST, has been approved for worldwide release. This publish includes the fixes listed in the “Publish 21 Updates & Bug Fixes” article of UO.com’s Update Center. However, there are three minor issues that remain to be addressed:

  • Using the “Sacred Journey” button on the 8th page of a runebook will not work.
  • Using “Sacred Journey” from a runebook will use double the normal Mana and tithe points.
  • If your pet is following you before it attacks a target, it will not continue to follow you unless tell it to do so.
We intend to fix these remaining issues with the next scheduled publish (Publish 22).

This publish will be released to each shard according to the schedule below:

  • East Coast USA Shards (Atlantic, Catskills, Chesapeake, Legends):
    5:00 am EST, Tuesday, November 25
    (10:00 am UTC/GMT, Tuesday, November 25)
  • Central USA Shards (Great Lakes, Lake Superior, Siege Perilous):
    5:00 am CST, Tuesday, November 25
    (11:00 am UTC/GMT, Tuesday, November 25)
  • West Coast USA Shards (Baja, Lake Austin, Napa Valley, Sonoma):
    5:00 am PST, Tuesday, November 25
    (1:00 pm UTC/GMT, Tuesday, November 25)
  • Australian Shard (Oceania):
    7:00 am AEDT, Wednesday, November 26
    (8:00 pm UTC/GMT, Tuesday, November 25)
  • Japanese Shards (Asuka, Hokuto, Izumo, Mizuho, Mugen, Sakura, Wakoku, Yamato):
    8:00 am JST, Wednesday, November 26
    (11:00 pm UTC/GMT, Tuesday, November 25)
  • Korean Shards (Arirang, Balhae):
    8:00 am KST, Wednesday, November 26
    (11:00 pm UTC/GMT, Tuesday, November 25)
    한국시간 11월26일 수요일 오전 8시입니다.
  • Taiwan Shard (Formosa):
    8:00 am CCT, Wednesday, November 26
    (12:00 am UTC/GMT, Wednesday, November 26)
  • European Shards (Drachenfels, Europa):
    5:00 am UTC/GMT, Wednesday, November 26
